versions.changelog:
Version 1.8.0 (qa-combination-strategy)

- Added a new reference file: references/reduction-strategies.md, moving detailed strategy explanations out of the main skill file.
- Streamlined SKILL.md by summarizing and offloading full content of "三种简化策略" to the new reference, reducing contextual payload during usage.
- Updated metadata fields for better maintainability (e.g., display name, version, when-to-use examples).
- Removed skill-card.md, further decluttering the project.
- No changes to core logic or workflow—main change is in documentation structure and references.

- Added slug and displayName fields to metadata for standardization.
- Incremented version to 1.6.3.
- skill-card.md removed from the project.
- No changes to skill logic or features; documentation and metadata only.

Version 1.6.0

- Added explicit traceability: each combination matrix now includes unique IDs and scenario links.
- Introduced safety warning regarding sensitive data and data masking for all examples.
- Clarified category metadata (Development, Testing).
- Removed file: skill-card.md.
- Improved markdown structure and grouped essential security and usage cautions at the top.

qa-combination-strategy v1.5.0

- Expanded input format: now explicitly supports场景树, 需求解构表, and optionally风险评估, with detailed structure requirements.
- Output format standardized to include组合矩阵, pairwise成对组合, N维组合, and标注覆盖遗漏.
- Added版本标识及策略深度与异常处理指导, including depth quantification, error fallback, and retry behavior.
- Removed legacy metadata file (skill-card.md) for simplification.
- Enhanced skill description to clarify application scenarios and emphasize risk-driven combination coverage.

- Documentation clarified and condensed; main strategy principles are unchanged.
- Simplified SKILL.md description to focus on skill triggers and efficient combination test design.
- Removed redundant explanations and details to enhance clarity for users.
- Deleted obsolete file "skill-card.md".

qa-combination-strategy v1.4.0

- Expanded and clarified skill description, including keyword triggers and broader intended use cases.
- Added a "策略选择速查表" and "常见反模式" sections for quick reference and anti-patterns.
- Enhanced parameter/trigger guidance in the when_to_use field.
- Improved structure and conciseness of main content for easier use.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Added detailed guidance on three main test combination simplification strategies: Pairwise, Orthogonal, and Risk-Weighted.
- Included parameter identification categories and risk assessment matrices to aid test design.
- Provided structured example for e-commerce order scenarios demonstrating the application of all strategies.
- Introduced step-by-step workflow and checklist for combination testing, improving consistency and coverage.
- Enhanced outputs with formats for test matrices and case templates for practical execution.
